annotations.title: See what to charge for a job

description: Use this when someone who does the work asks what to charge, e.g. "what should I charge to mow a lawn", "how much do people pay for TV mounting", "what can I make doing yard cleanup". Returns the middle budget and the middle half of budgets homeowners set when they posted that job on GigNGo, with how many posts it counts and a link to the earnings guide. These are budgets from across the US, not prices paid for finished jobs and not what any local earned: say so, with the number of posts. A job with fewer than 5 posts has no figure; the reply then lists the jobs that do. Pass on the `limits` field.

job.description: The job in a few words, e.g. "lawn mowing", "furniture assembly", "tv mounting".
